description: This file implements functions related to fixed-offset time zones, including parsing zone names, converting offsets to names, and generating abbreviations. It is part of the internal cctz namespace within the absl library.

methods.name: Format02d
methods.description: Formats an integer as a two-digit string into a character buffer.

methods.name: Parse02d
methods.description: Parses a two-digit number from a string, returning -1 if invalid.

methods.name: FixedOffsetFromName
methods.description: Parses a fixed-offset zone name into a seconds offset.

methods.name: FixedOffsetToName
methods.description: Converts a seconds offset into a fixed-offset zone name string.

methods.name: FixedOffsetToAbbr
methods.description: Generates a short abbreviation for a fixed-offset zone based on its offset.

search-terms: absl time internal cctz fixed offset
